### Bug Description

Whenever I'm playing normally, my entire pc suddenly freezes and then goes on ~1 fps, minecraft says 11 fps, but my mouse movement is smooth (the graphics driver got hung).

It produces an error visible through Reliability Monitor aswell, here it is:

### Reproduction Steps

It's not easily reproducable, but I'm on 1.21.10 modrinth with sodium mc1.21.10-0.7.3-fabric. It happens every ~10 mins, sometimes every 1 min or sometimes 30+ mins. Seems to happen most when opening UI.

Here's what's genuinely confirmed (not guessed) from this whole conversation, worth adding:

Already ruled out (tested individually, issue persisted each time):

Meteor Client — disabled entirely, still happens
Polytone — disabled, still happens
Iris (and Photon shaders) — disabled, kept Sodium active, still happens
So this occurs with just Sodium + Fabric API + minor mods (Fullbright UB, e4mc) — no Iris, no Polytone, no Meteor

Confirmed NOT caused by (checked and ruled out):

Discord overlay — disabled, still happens
GPU temps — normal throughout (max ~64°C core, ~81°C hotspot), not thermal
Nvidia Threaded Optimization manually set to Off for javaw.exe — no change
V-Sync (off in Nvidia Control Panel) and Low Latency Mode (off) — not the cause

Confirmed environmental/system facts:

GPU: RTX 2070 (MSI Ventus OC)
Driver: 591.86 (WHQL, released Jan 27, 2026)
CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (no integrated GPU — RTX 2070 is the sole display output)
Same exact mod set (Iris, Sodium, Meteor, and many more) ran with zero issues for an extended period on a previous Windows 10 installation on this same PC/GPU — issue only began after a fresh Windows 11 install
Never occurs in any other game (including Roblox, played far more frequently) — Minecraft-exclusive
Sodium's own log confirms it auto-detects Nvidia and applies a workaround: Sodium has applied one or more workarounds to prevent crashes or other issues on your system: [NVIDIA_THREADED_OPTIMIZATIONS_BROKEN], and separately logs Enabling GL_DEBUG_OUTPUT_SYNCHRONOUS to force the NVIDIA driver to disable threaded command submission
Minecraft's own log shows a clean, silent gap during each freeze (no warnings/errors/exceptions) — confirms this is invisible to Java, a driver-level hang, not a game-code bug
Reliability Monitor logs the identical LiveKernelEvent codes (1a8 and 1b8) every single occurrence — consistent, repeatable signature, not random/varied hardware faults

That last "same mods, same GPU, worked fine on Windows 10" point is probably the single most useful thing to make sure is in there — it strongly suggests something Windows-11-environment-specific rather than a mod bug at all, which the maintainers may not have considered.

[comment by jellysquid3 (member)]
> A problem with your hardware caused Windows to stop working correctly.

Windows is very plainly telling you that the NVIDIA graphics card in your computer is faulting. This is not a bug with Sodium or any other application. The fact that your computer enters "limp mode" after the hang is because the graphics driver has been unloaded, as the hardware device is in an unrecoverable state and the only way out is a complete reboot.

It may be the case that Sodium more easily provokes this issue, but that doesn't mean anything other than the particular workload is especially stressful on your hardware.

It could be a graphics driver bug, or simply that your hardware is faulty and becomes especially prone to crashing when temperatures get too hot.
